events.title: The moments people plan for months
events.text: A big event starts with one idea: a colour, a fabric, a flower. I build everything else around it.

hafrasha.name: Hafrashat challah evening
hafrasha.text: A gathering where a bride and the women close to her bake challah and say blessings before the wedding. Flowing white fabric, candles, white and cream flowers, tables set with care.

wedding.name: Weddings
wedding.text: Welcome display, bridal bouquet and bridal car decoration, all in the same design language.

mitzva.name: Bar & bat mitzvah
mitzva.text: The coming-of-age celebration at 13 (12 for girls). Photo wall, balloon wall and welcome table matched to the age, style and venue.

evjf.name: Bachelorette parties
evjf.text: A custom-printed wall, handmade bows, floating candles and a cocktail glass tower.

services.title: Twelve ways to celebrate
services.text: From a single balloon bouquet to a full hall. Choose what suits you, and I make sure it looks exactly as you pictured it.

photo.name: Photo walls
photo.text: Custom-designed backdrops with names, a date and a look that fits the event.

balloons.name: Balloons
balloons.text: Arches, walls and helium bouquets. Yes, balloons alone can turn a restaurant into a party.

flowers.name: Flowers
flowers.text: Fresh flowers for tables and displays, birthday bouquets and bridal bouquets.

hafrasha.name: Hafrashat challah
hafrasha.text: Full design for the evening: fabric, candles, flowers and table settings.

evjf.name: Bachelorette
evjf.text: A wall in the bride’s style: bows, boho chic, pink stripes or something completely new.

mitzva.name: Bar & bat mitzvah
mitzva.text: Photo walls, balloons and a welcome table made to measure.

birth.name: Brit, britah & zeved habat
birth.text: Ceremonies welcoming a newborn. Soft displays in dusty pink, pearl and stone, or light blue and white for a brit.

birthday.name: Birthdays
birthday.text: From a balloon arch to a full display with a “Happy Birthday” sign at the right age.

room.name: Room surprises
room.text: A surprise room at home or in a hotel: balloons, flowers and anything you want to add.

numbers.name: Giant numbers
numbers.text: Decorated giant numbers for an age or a date, for a photo people remember.

special.name: Tu B’Av & special dates
special.text: A proposal, an anniversary or Tu B’Av, the Israeli day of love. A small moment with a big design.

shop.title: You order, I prepare
shop.text: Fixed-price pieces you can order directly: choose colours, a date and a message, then confirm on WhatsApp.
shop.pageIntro: Gifts and small designs you can order in a few taps. Each order is handmade and confirmed with you on WhatsApp before I start.

bubble-balloon.name: Personalised bubble balloon

flower-bouquet.name: Flower bouquet
flower-bouquet.text: Fresh flowers in the shades you pick, wrapped and ready to give.

room-surprise.name: Surprise room set-up
room-surprise.text: Balloons on the ceiling, the bed and the floor, numbers for the age and flowers of your choice.

giant-numbers.name: Giant numbers

car-kit.name: Bridal car decoration

steps.title: Three steps, then you just show up

items.title: Tell me about your event
items.text: Date, venue, number of guests and the style you like. Feel free to send photos that inspire you.

items.title: I suggest a custom design
items.text: Colours, materials and a clear quote. We adjust until it feels exactly right.

items.title: On the day, I set everything up
items.text: I arrive before you, set up, arrange and check every detail, so you walk into a finished room.

about.title: I’m Stav
about.p1: I’m an event designer based in Ashkelon. Photo walls, hafrashat challah evenings, weddings, balloons and flowers: every event starts with a conversation and ends with me setting it up on site.
about.p2: What drives me is precision. Fabric that falls just right, a bow that sits straight, a flower shade that matches the sign. Nobody notices these details one by one, but everyone feels them together.
about.p3: Nothing beats the message that arrives after the event: “It’s exactly what I imagined.” That message is why I keep creating.
about.abroad: I have also designed an event in Montenegro. Planning something abroad? Write to me.

legal.title: Accessibility and privacy
a11y: This site is built to work with a keyboard, screen readers and enlarged text, following WCAG 2.1 level AA and Israeli Standard 5568.
Every image has a text description, text contrast has been checked, and animations stop when your device asks for reduced motion.
Found a problem? Message me on WhatsApp and I’ll fix it as soon as possible.
privacy: This site does not store what you type into the forms. It only goes into the WhatsApp message you choose to send.
Your device only remembers the language you picked and whether you’ve already seen the opening animation. No advertising cookies, no tracking.
